steps.action: Archive and restore primary paper with its designation and Versions retained
steps.actual: Archive hid the primary row from the ordinary list and Show archived exposed it; its saved primary designation remained. Restore returned the same Document and Version chain without selecting another primary

steps.action: Archived types are unavailable and a blank title cannot create an item
steps.actual: Create item stayed disabled without Title; the separately prepared archived Knowledge type was absent from the reader-facing picker

steps.action: Move and reorder a Knowledge Folder while retaining its items
steps.actual: Parent folder moved the whole child tree under a new parent; Move up changed that parent by one sibling position; its descendant Knowledge Item remained visible
